chemistry-killer-05.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
chemistry-killer-05.topic: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
chemistry-killer-05.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-05.material:
I-0.1 M $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ yongezwa kwi-50 mL ye-0.2 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$, kwaye inani eliphelele lee-ion (mmol) kwisisombululo liyarekhodwa. Amanzi awabalwa njengee-ion, kwaye kwenzeka kuphela $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- ightarrow H_2O}$.
Umthamo we-NaOH(aq) owongeziweyo (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Ii-ion zizonke (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Xa i-150 mL ye-NaOH(aq) iyongeziwe, sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo umlinganiselo wenani $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ kungxubevange kunye ne-(ii-ion zizonke emva kokuxuba) / (ii-ion zizonke ekuqaleni kwi-50 mL ye-HCl(aq) kunye ne-150 mL ye-NaOH(aq)), ngokulandelelana? (Hoya ukuzahlula kwamanzi ngokwawo ukuba ngee-ion.)
chemistry-killer-05.thinking.0: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction

Umthamo we-NaOH(aq) owongeziweyo (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Ii-ion zizonke (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Xa i-150 mL ye-NaOH(aq) iyongeziwe, sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo umlinganiselo wenani $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ kungxubevange kunye ne-(ii-ion zizonke emva kokuxuba) / (ii-ion zizonke ekuqaleni kwi-50 mL ye-HCl(aq) kunye ne-150 mL ye-NaOH(aq)), ngokulandelelana? (Hoya ukuzahlula kwamanzi ngokwawo ukuba ngee-ion.)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukufunda itheyibhile. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (indawo yokungathathi cala). Kude kube sesi sithuba i-H+ nganye ifakelwa yi-Na+, ngoko isiphumo siyahlala sihleli.
Inyathelo 2: Kwi-150 mL i-NaOH inika i-Na+ 15 mmol kunye ne-OH- 15 mmol. I-10 mmol ye-OH- isabela ne-10 mmol ye-H+, kushiyeke i-OH- 5 mmol. Ii-ion: Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5, umlinganiselo 3 : 2 : 1, iyonke 30 mmol.
Inyathelo 3: Ii-ion ngaphambi kokuxuba = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Umlinganiselo = 30/50 = 3/5.
Iimpendulo: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-OH- = 15 ihoya ukungathathi cala; i-5/3 iphendula umlinganiselo; i-3/4 ibala ii-ion ngaphambi kokuxuba njenge-40.)

chemistry-killer-05.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
